decision: Warning (Article 12.3.1.a of the FIA International Sporting Code)
event_name: Date 23 October 2020 Time 18:56 2020 PORTUGUESE GRAND PRIX 22 to 25 October The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 20), summoned (document 21) and heard from the team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Used an incorrect tyre in a set.
offence: Breach of Article 24.2 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Warning (Article 12.3.1.a of the FIA International Sporting Code)
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative. It was agreed that the team used the incorrect left front tyre from a set of a different specification which is an offence with no apparent sporting benefit to the team as the set in question was a development set.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Renault Tyre Use
